## About
Brad Higgins Landscape Services sells sod from a central location on the South Freeway in Houston. Whether you're a landscaper buying wholesale or a homeowner doing one yard, you can pick up here or have it delivered.
Beyond selling grass, we install sod and handle irrigation installation and repair, so the lawn and the water that keeps it going can come from the same crew.
Our philosophy is to offer the best sod and landscape products at the most efficient cost for residential and commercial jobs. Give us a call to set up an appointment.

## Services
- Installing sod: We lay sod for your yard. One customer wrote about us installing both their sprinkler system and sod.
- Sod delivery: Quality sod from our central location, available for pick up at the yard or delivered to you.
- Wholesale and retail sod: We sell sod to landscapers and contractors as well as to homeowners.
- Irrigation installation and repair: New sprinkler systems put in, and existing ones fixed when something goes wrong.
- Freight services: Freight services are available. Call to talk through what you need moved.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: Yes, please call ahead to set up an appointment.

Q: Do you work on commercial properties?
A: Yes. We supply sod and landscape products for both residential and commercial needs.

Q: Where are you located?
A: Our yard is on the South Freeway in Houston.
